verses.verse:
द्वितीयोऽपि प्रकारः स्याद् बंशी निंर्माण कर्मणि।
निर्माणे येन सौविध्यं सर्वथा स्यात्सुरैषिणाम्।47।
verses.text: There is a second method too in the work of making the bānsurī, by which those who seek tunefulness may find every convenience in the making.

verses.verse:
बंशादौ मुखरः प्रोक्तः बंशान्ते पंचमः स्थितः।
मध्यान्ते तु विनिर्णीताः क्रमात् सर्वे स्वरा इह।48।
verses.text: At the start of the bamboo the mouth-hole is set, at the end of the bamboo stands Pa; and from the middle to the end all the notes are here fixed in order.

commentary.text: That is, for the convenience of makers a second method is also being given. Here the mukharandhra (mouth-hole) is at the start of the bamboo, Pañcama (P̣a) at the end, and all the remaining notes are placed from the middle to the end. See Figure No. 16.
